package.description: A fast, native-feeling desktop client for YouTube Music

en-US.description: A fast, native-feeling desktop client for YouTube Music
en-US.longDescription:
Zuno brings YouTube Music to the desktop as a focused application rather than a browser tab.
It plays audio natively, with gapless playback, crossfade and a ten-band equaliser, and keeps
synced lyrics, offline downloads, tabs and a mini player close at hand.

Zuno is an independent, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with, authorized by,
sponsored by, or endorsed by YouTube or Google.
en-US.name: Zuno
en-US.releaseNotes:
Highlights
- Offline mode: downloads play with their artwork and no connection. Zuno starts offline with your library intact, and Last.fm scrobbles are sent once you're back online.
- Sound: volume normalization, speed and pitch as separate controls, no more pause between gapless tracks, and an equaliser you draw on a live response graph.
- Mini player skins: Cassette, Vinyl and Y2K alongside Classic.
- Windows on ARM: native ARM64 builds.
Playback & sound
- Volume normalization (Settings → Playback) turns loud tracks down to YouTube's reference level. Rust engine.
- Changing speed keeps the pitch, and a new pitch control (±12 semitones) keeps the speed. Rust engine.
- Equaliser: drag nodes or draw a curve on the real response graph, save your own presets, and use Auto preamp to stay clear of the limiter. New Warm and Loudness presets.
- Fixed: songs playing sped up and high-pitched on the Rust engine, and the speed control doing nothing.
- Fixed: a pause between gapless tracks.
- A stream that keeps cutting out a few seconds in now finishes on the YouTube player instead of skipping.
- The Rust engine recovers when the audio device goes away instead of freezing.
- Fixed: media keys skipping two tracks on Windows.
- The seek bar shows hours on long tracks.
Offline & downloads
- Downloads keep their cover art, in the app and in the OS media controls.
- Launching offline keeps you signed in with your cached library. Home lists your downloads and search finds them.
- Next and previous step over songs that aren't downloaded, and those rows are dimmed.
- The download queue pauses while offline and resumes on reconnect.
- Redesigned downloads menu: progress ring, storage meter, retry or dismiss for failures, and recent saves.
- Fixed: failed downloads never showing up, and a cancelled download still being saved.
- Fixed: every stream skipping after a few seconds following an offline launch.
Library & interface
- Pin playlists to the top of the sidebar. Hidden playlists leave the sidebar too.
- Sort order is remembered across tabs and restarts.
- Click a cover to see it full size.
- App zoom from 80% to 200%: Settings → Appearance, or Ctrl/⌘ with + and −.
- Search across all settings.
- Fixed: tooltips running off screen, carousel cards stacking in the wrong order, and clipped Home icons.
Lyrics
- SimpMusic added as a synced lyrics source.
- Search lyrics by hand with your own title and artist. A synced match replaces the cached one.
- New extra-small text size.
- Fixed: opening lyrics spiking memory by up to ~4 GB.
- Fixed: synced lyrics missing after auto-advance, and the preferred source resetting on restart.
Mini player & window
- Mini player skins: Classic, Cassette, Vinyl and Y2K.
- Scroll-wheel volume on the Classic skin. Right-click the close button for "Don't show again". Near the top of the screen, the capsule expands downward.
- Optional window outline. "Minimize to tray" moved to the Window tab, and the tray icon only shows while it's on.
- Fixed: the main window restoring at the wrong size with native decorations.
Accounts & sign-in
- The Google sign-in window shows the page address, so a lookalike page is easy to spot.
- Fixed: Windows sign-in failing with error 8.
- Fixed: the sign-in window hanging, and a failed or cancelled "add account" signing you out.
- Fixed: sign-in failing on macOS behind TLS-inspecting proxies or antivirus, and on Linux when saving the session overwhelmed the keyring.
Linux
- Fixed: crash on launch under Wayland on NVIDIA (Error 71).
- Fixed: the desktop media widget lagging behind track changes, and showing a stale position while Zuno sits in the tray.
- Desktop media widgets can show and change Zuno's volume.
Discord
- Hide your status while paused.
- Fixed: a release year shown as the artist, and the wrong song when skipping quickly.
Reliability & performance
- Restore tabs and queues works again: saved data now survives restarts.
- A failed settings save no longer wipes your settings.
- If Zuno can't start, it now says why instead of showing an empty window.
- Lighter and faster: heavy work moved off the main thread, binary IPC for audio, less GPU use and fewer re-renders, plus a low-memory mode while hidden on Windows.
Contributors
Thanks to @zebus3d (mini player, window settings, sign-in address bar, Linux media volume), @junzhengca (Windows ARM64), @SyahrulBhudiF (settings search, Discord hide when paused) and @csarnataro (seek bar hours).
Full changelog: v1.4.0...v1.5.0
